subject: Proposal: availability guarantees + tiered retainer scaffold
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Logan Pierce <logan@compasscloud.com>, Emma Roberts <emma@compasscloud.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Proposal: availability guarantees + tiered retainer scaffold

Hi Logan / Emma,

Thanks again for the demo last week — great discussion on predictable latency and the multi-region failover requirement. Attached is a first-pass scaffold that maps (1) uptime bands, (2) response SLAs, (3) retainer structures, and (4) discount tiers tied to annual commits. The goal here is to make the trade-offs explicit so procurement can sign off quickly.

Highlights: 
- 99.9% / 99.95% / 99.99% uptime bands with explicit credit slabs.
- Response windows (P1/P2/P3) and what’s included in each retainer level.
- A two-year discount ladder for 12/24/36 month commits and an onboarding credit for the first month.

Ask: Can you confirm which uptime band CompassCloud needs for production (we surfaced 99.95% as the working target)? Also, please flag any procurement terms we should pre-accept (term length, auto-renew, PO vs invoice).

Attached: guarantee_scaffold_v1.pdf (high-level) — I’ll follow with a detailed pricing matrix.

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Logan Pierce <logan@compasscloud.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Emma Roberts <emma@compasscloud.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Dec 2026 10:50:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Proposal: availability guarantees + tiered retainer scaffold

Ben — thanks for the doc. A few quick questions from our side: 

1) Can you show the dollar impact by monthly run-rate for each uptime band (not just credits)? We want to understand both the cost and the credit model.
2) For P1 response, do you include engineer-led on-call for the top tier or is that an add-on?
3) If we commit to a 24-month, $1.2M ARR equivalent, what’s the maximum discount you can extend and what SLAs are moveable?

Also, procurement asked for a sample contract redline — I’ll loop legal if we get close.

— Logan
Logan Pierce
Head of Platform Engineering
CompassCloud
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Logan Pierce <logan@compasscloud.com>, Emma Roberts <emma@compasscloud.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 12 Dec 2026 08:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Proposal: availability guarantees + tiered retainer scaffold

Logan — good questions. I attached a worked matrix that converts uptime bands into monthly unit economics and shows the net effective price after expected credits (SLA_pricing_matrix_v2.xlsx). Summary below: 

- Monthly run-rate example (based on your ~50M tokens/month):
  • 99.9%: baseline $X/month, expected credits ~1.2% effective cost uplift in worst case
  • 99.95%: +~14% over baseline (includes faster routing & higher reserved capacity)
  • 99.99%: +~32% over baseline (reserved pools, multi-region warm failover)

- P1 (Critical): included for Premium retainer (Tier 3) — direct engineer escalation, 2-hour response, hotfix SLA; Tier 2 includes 4-hour response with phone escalation as an add-on.

- For a 24-month, $1.2M commit we can do: 
  • 10% list discount off baseline + 25% onboarding credit applied month 1 (one-time) OR
  • 7% + extended payment terms (net 60) if you prefer cashflow relief.

I’m happy to model a blended scenario if you share target gross margin for the project.

Attached: SLA_pricing_matrix_v2.xlsx — contains the per-band dollar rows.

Ben
——

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Logan Pierce <logan@compasscloud.com>, Emma Roberts <emma@compasscloud.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 14:00:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Proposal: availability guarantees + tiered retainer scaffold

Logan / Emma — picking this up. Ben’s matrix is the baseline; two finer points from an operations perspective: 

1) Escalation coverage — we propose a named on-call rotation for Tier 3 customers (primary + secondary engineers). That rotation is time-boxed (first 12 months) and then transitions to an engagement-based callback model unless you opt to continue the rotation as part of a renewal.

2) Discount scaffolding — to make approvals easy we recommend the following conditional discounts (detailed in attached v3):
   - 12 months: list price (no additional discount) + onboarding credit 15%
   - 24 months: 10% off list + onboarding credit 25%
   - 36 months: 15% off list + onboarding credit 30% + guaranteed renewal cap (max 3% annual price increase)

We also inserted a one-time engineering migration credit to offset go-live risk. See SLA_pricing_matrix_v3.xlsx for the worked examples and per-band run-rate columns.

If CompassCloud’s procurement needs a pre-approved clause set, we can provide a limited redline that accepts PO billing, standard indemnities, and a clarified data residency paragraph (applies for 99.99% only).

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Proposal: availability guarantees + tiered retainer scaffold

Logan / Emma / Contracts — thanks for the back-and-forth. To summarize and propose next steps: 

1) Offer summary (attached): 24-month commitment at $1.2M ARR-equivalent with 10% discount, 25% onboarding credit month 1, Tier 3 (99.95% target) by default, P1 included for Tier 3.
2) Ops commitment: 12-month named on-call rotation included, then optional for renewal.
3) Procurement: we can accept PO billing and provide a limited redline for standard terms. I’ve attached the negotiated pricing matrix and a marked-up term sheet (compasscloud_term_sheet_comments.pdf).

Next steps: 
- If this aligns, let me know and I’ll circulate a DocuSign link for signature and a HubSpot deal update (link below).
- If legal wants redlines, please send them to me and copy Marissa; we’ll triage and produce a single consolidated redline within 48 business hours.

DocuSign (proposal): https://docusign.com/s/REDWOOD-CC-202612
HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.com/deals/CC-202612-REDWOOD-1

Thanks — looking forward to closing this out before the end of the quarter.

Ben
